headline: MINRES AND GANFENG COMMIT A$490 MILLION TO MT MARION: Lithium Gets Underground Mine and New Flotation Plant
snippet: Mineral Resources (ASX: MIN) and JV partner Jiangxi Ganfeng Lithium approved a final investment decision to build a flotation plant and underground mine at Mt Marion in Western Australia, with total capex of A$490 million across FY27–28. Plant recovery targets lift to 70% and the lower-grade SC3.5 product is eliminated, delivering a single SC5 concentrate. MinRes shares hit a two-year high of A$72.94 on the announcement.

headline: PORPHYRY CONFIRMED AT DEPTH IN ARGENTINA: Kobrea's El Perdido Phase 1 Drilling Hits Strengthening Cu-Au-Mo System
snippet: Kobrea Exploration (CSE: KBX) completed 2,358 metres of diamond drilling across six holes at El Perdido in Mendoza Province, Argentina, confirming a large hydrothermal porphyry system with copper, gold, molybdenum and silver mineralisation. Crucially, alteration intensity, veining and sulphide assemblages increase with depth — the hallmark of proximity to a porphyry core — setting up Phase 2 targeting at a time when copper trades near record highs above $6/lb.

headline: 39.5 g/t GOLD EQUIVALENT: Cygnus Metals Completes Golden Eye Infill Assays as Chibougamau Resource Upgrade Looms
snippet: Cygnus Metals (TSXV: CYG) received final infill drill results from the Golden Eye deposit at its Chibougamau Copper-Gold Project in Quebec, including top intercepts of 39.5 g/t AuEq (35.0 g/t Au, 3.1% Cu, 30.6 g/t Ag) over 3 metres. Golden Eye sits within 3 km of an existing process plant with double-ramp access; a formal mineral resource upgrade incorporating the full infill dataset is now being compiled.

headline: FIRST PASS DONE IN CHILE: Montero Mining Wraps Elvira Drill Program — Six Holes Confirm Large Gold-Copper Porphyry System
snippet: Montero Mining and Exploration (TSXV: MON) completed its initial six-hole, 2,358-metre first-pass drill program at the Elvira Gold Project in Chile's porphyry belt, confirming a large hydrothermal system carrying gold, copper, molybdenum and silver. Geological observations show alteration and sulphide intensity strengthen at depth, pointing to an under-drilled porphyry core beneath the current footprint.

headline: Zodiac Gold Traces 700m Priority Corridor at Todi and COMMENCES DRILLING at Ben Ben North — West Africa District-Scale Target
snippet: Zodiac Gold (TSXV: ZAU) confirmed a continuous northwest-trending corridor of gold mineralisation at Ben Ben North measuring 700 metres in strike length at its Todi Gold Project in Liberia — now elevated to high-priority — and simultaneously commenced diamond drilling on the target as part of a 14,000-metre 2026 exploration strategy along the 16 km Monterra Trend.

headline: 26.53 g/t GOLD FROM 76m DEPTH: Nexus Minerals Hits High Grades at Wallbrook's Clement Prospect — All 10 RC Holes Mineralised
snippet: Nexus Minerals (ASX: NXM) returned standout results from the first 10 holes of a planned 33-hole RC program at Clement within its Wallbrook Gold Project near Kalgoorlie, WA — every hole hit anomalous gold, with the best intercept at 12m at 3.81 g/t Au including 1m at 26.53 g/t within a broader 19m at 2.51 g/t from 76m. Results confirm a stacked multi-lode system; a multi-prospect resource update is planned for later in 2026.

headline: Solis Minerals Locks in June Drill Start at Former Rio Tinto Brazil Lithium Package — 2,000m Scout Program at Mandacaru and Campo Grande
snippet: Solis Minerals (ASX: SLM / TSXV: SLMN) confirmed a drilling contractor and June start date for a 2,000-metre scout program at its Mandacaru and Campo Grande lithium prospects in Brazil — a district-scale package acquired from Rio Tinto earlier this year. Both targets show LCT pathfinder signatures at surface indicative of spodumene-bearing pegmatite systems; assays expected six to eight weeks post-drill.
